source.name: Football Shirt Culture, Fiorentina 2026-27 Home Kit by Joma Revealed
source.quote: Mediacom remains the main front sponsor, applied in white across the chest.

source.name: ACF Fiorentina, bet365 Scores Becomes ACF Fiorentina's New Sleeve Jersey Partner
source.quote: the bet365 Scores logo will appear on the sleeve of the Men's First Team jersey in all official competitions

source.name: Joma, Joma to kit out ACF Fiorentina from the 2026/27 season
source.quote: Spanish brand Joma will become the new official technical sponsor of ACF Fiorentina
source.note: Kit maker (technical sponsor), not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: Joma's first Fiorentina home shirt (centenary season): Mediacom on the front, bet365 Scores on the sleeve from August 2026, no back or shorts sponsor on the launch kit.
